dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent irregular ring structures observed along the mid-dorsal flank; edges are characterized by a soft-transition gradient from dark charcoal exterior to light-grey interior. Structures include one closed ellipse and four fragmented C-shaped arcs.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized light-intensity pixel clusters concentrated on the anterior-lateral region near the neck and lower flank; these clusters are primarily solid, asymmetrical shapes lacking internal color gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest annuli on the upper mid-flank form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest axis oriented roughly parallel to the dorsal line.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast light fur pattern surrounding the eyes and muzzle, creating a mask-like facial geometry.
